Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Blazor Dashboard, SignalR Hub & Live Monitoring Infrastructure
Content:
The Blazor Server dashboard (`WebUI.Blazor`) provides real-time agent visibility via REST endpoints, SignalR push, and a static HTML dashboard. It is the primary human interface for monitoring the agent.

## Architecture

The Blazor app hosts all monitoring infrastructure in one process:

| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| REST API | `/api/agent/*`, `/api/goals/*`, `/api/tools/*`, `/api/journal/*`, `/api/chat/*` |
| SignalR Hub | `/hubs/monitor` via `AgentHub` — real-time push to dashboard clients |
| `AgentBackgroundService` | `IHostedService` — agent lifecycle and event processing |
| `LiveLogBuffer` | In-memory ring buffer (1000 entries) for recent log events |
| `DashboardPublisherImpl` | `IDashboardPublisher` — periodic status snapshot publishing |

No separate queue, database, or broker — all in-process.

## REST Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|--------|
| `/api/agent/status` | GET | Current agent state (goal, connection, inventory, position, nearby entities, block below) |
| `/api/agent/plan` | POST | Set a goal: `{goalName, parameters}` |
| `/api/agent/stop` | POST | Stop agent (`?emergency=true` for emergency stop) |
| `/api/agent/command` | POST | Execute arbitrary action |
| `/api/goals` | GET | List available goal types |
| `/api/goals` | DELETE | Cancel current goal |
| `/api/tools` | GET | List all registered tools with schemas |
| `/api/journal` | GET | Recent journal entries |
| `/api/chat` | GET | Recent chat messages |
| `/api/diagnostics` | GET | Diagnostic info (requires auth) |
| `/about` | GET | Dashboard about page |

## AgentHub (SignalR)

Located in `WebUI.Blazor/AgentHub.cs`. Clients join `"dashboard"` group on connect:

- `OnConnectedAsync`: `Groups.AddToGroupAsync(ConnectionId, "dashboard")`
- `OnDisconnectedAsync`: `Groups.RemoveFromGroupAsync`
- Hub path: `/hubs/monitor`

### SignalR Events Published

| Event Constant | DTO | Description |
|----------------|-----|-------------|
| `DashboardHubEvents.SnapshotUpdated` | `AgentStatusUpdate` | Periodic agent status snapshot (health, food, pos, inventory, entities) |
| `ChatMessage` | string | In-game chat relay |
| `GoalUpdate` | string | Goal lifecycle events (started, completed, failed) |
| `LogEntry` | `DashboardLogEntry` | Structured log messages from `LiveLogBuffer` |

## LiveLogBuffer (`WebUI.Blazor/Dashboard/Logging/LiveLogBuffer.cs`)

Bounded in-memory ring buffer of recent `DashboardLogEntry` records:

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Capacity | 1000 entries (default) |
| Thread safety | `ConcurrentQueue` — thread-safe |
| Eviction | Oldest entries dropped when full (`while (_entries.Count > _capacity && _entries.TryDequeue(out _)) { }`) |

**Methods:**

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `Add(entry)` | Enqueues entry, drops oldest if at capacity |
| `GetLatest(count = 100)` | Returns latest N entries, oldest first (dashboard auto-scrolls to newest) |
| `Count` | Current number of entries |
| `Clear()` | Empties the buffer |

Used by the dashboard timeline endpoint to surface recent Warning/Information/Error log events without querying rolling files.

## DashboardPublisherImpl (`IDashboardPublisher`)

Located in `WebUI.Blazor/Managers/DashboardPublisherImpl.cs`. Concrete implementation that sends agent status updates to connected dashboard clients via SignalR.

### State Setters

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `SetCurrentGoal(goalName, goalDescription)` | Updates current goal metadata for subsequent publishes |
| `SetConsecutiveFailures(count)` | Sets the consecutive failure counter |
| `SetNearbyEntities(entities)` | Sprint 55 Wave C: updates observed entities for dashboard display |
| `SetBlockBelow(blockName)` | Sprint 55 Wave C: updates block below bot's feet |

### PublishStatusAsync

Reads `IStateManager.Current` to populate the `AgentStatusUpdate` DTO, then sends via `IHubContext<AgentHub>.Clients.Group("dashboard").SendAsync(DashboardHubEvents.SnapshotUpdated, update, ct)`.

Error handling: `OperationCanceledException` re-thrown; all other exceptions logged as warning and swallowed (non-fatal for publish loop).

## AgentStatusUpdate DTO

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `Status` | string | `"active"` \| `"idle"` \| `"reconnecting"` \| `"disconnected"` |
| `Goal` | string? | Current goal name, or null if idle |
| `GoalDescription` | string? | Human-readable goal description |
| `Health` | int | Agent health (0–20) |
| `Food` | int | Agent food level (0–20) |
| `X`, `Y`, `Z` | int | World coordinates |
| `QueuedActions` | int | Number of actions in dispatch queue |
| `ConsecutiveFailures` | int | Running count of consecutive action failures |
| `Inventory` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int>` | Item → count snapshot |
| `NearbyEntities` | `IReadOnlyList<ObservedEntityDto>?` | Observed entities near the bot (null if none) |
| `BlockBelow` | string? | Block below the bot's feet (null if unknown) |

## ObservedEntityDto

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `Name` | string | Entity display name |
| `Type` | string | Entity type (`"mob"`, `"object"`, `"player"`) |
| `Hostile` | bool | Whether the entity is a known hostile mob |
| `X`, `Y`, `Z` | int | Entity position |
| `Distance` | double | Euclidean distance from the bot |
| `Health` | int? | Entity health (if available) |
| `Username` | string? | Player username (if applicable) |
